items.title: Artie Shaw — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: when Red was looking for people, he told me to go over and rehearse and audition.

ctx.x: Arthur Michaud was a guy who took care of Bunny, got him work. Arthur was a businessman. He was in the insurance business, but he hung out on the fringes of the jazz world, and when Red was looking for people, he told me to go over and rehearse and audition. He said to me, not too many years ago, he said to me, “When Red called me, he said, ‘That kid’s never going to get anywhere’.”
Is that what Red Nichols said?
